payload.text: Intent's swap (vc's announce of 22 Oct, 18:53Z; Intent issue 0612, board@4.0). Before intent-vc's START, dc commits its pending board renders. After the swap, dc commits no board file until vc says its board@4.0 re-render commit is in, and from then on only the paths its verb prints on wrote: lines, never a re-rendered: line, which is another node's (wb-commit-dc.sh's rule is retired then). No heavy run GOes between intent-vc's START and END. A running intent mcp server keeps the old code, so dc writes through the CLI. dc's inbox watch stays off until the re-render is in, so a peer wakes dc by socket.
